intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: Pinned TypeScript handler throws MethodNotImplementedError and its generated Swift contract exposes a whole Data output.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: Streams proposal-0016 two-root full-recovery CARs from a private bounded-memory spool; the generated handler is retained for typed parameter/context semantics but its Data-returning method is never used by the transport.

intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: Pinned notifyWrite rejects a request unless auth.credentials.iss equals body.repo, but its authority fanout signs iss as ownerDid while retaining a member writer in body.repo; the resulting cross-host fanout shape is not accepted by that same pinned receiver when owner and writer differ.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: Emits and accepts only direct writer-to-authority notifications with iss equal to repo and an exact configured authority service identity as aud. It intentionally does not emit or accept authority-signed cross-host write fanout; registrations remain discovery state and notifySpaceDeleted remains the separate authority-signed tombstone control plane.

compatibilityExceptions.referenceBehavior: POST /:did ends in Express res.sendStatus(200), producing status 200, Content-Type text/plain; charset=utf-8, and the two ASCII bytes OK.
compatibilityExceptions.swanBehavior: Only explicit laboratory policy did-plc-server-0.0.1 accepts that exact no-redirect response at the requested URL; production and all PLC JSON reads retain strict validation.

compatibilityExceptions.referenceBehavior: com.atproto.space.listRepoOps returns InternalServerError when values are included because the joined SQLite query leaves the space selector ambiguous; excludeValues=true remains callable.
compatibilityExceptions.swanBehavior: Qualifies the joined space selector and serves value-bearing operations. The interop runner exposes an explicit excludeValues mode for the pinned branch and never mutates the reference cache.

compatibilityExceptions.referenceBehavior: An old since cursor is filtered with rev > since and returns HTTP 200; the pinned handler does not emit full_repo_recovery_required for a retention gap.
compatibilityExceptions.swanBehavior: Emits HTTP 409 full_repo_recovery_required when its retained range is exceeded. The recovery CLI remains strict by default and exposes an explicit --allow-full-car-fallback only for qualified reference-host full-CAR testing; fallback artifacts are excluded from retention-gap validation.
